messages:
maria: Heads up — we're seeing a spike in spot preemptions across us-west2 GPUs (multiple H100/A100 jobs got evicted). Can someone approve a temporary borrow of 4x A100s from the partner edge pool for ~6h to run a canary and drain live jobs? vendor-bot: pinging acme-rep :bell:
acme-rep: Hi Maria — saw the ping. We have 4 units in the satellite edge pool but need a formal borrow ticket + quick tf change. I can approve on my side if ops ok.:thumbsup:
kevin: If we bring them up, we'll need to lower batch sizes and enable kv-cache for canary. Otherwise latency will spike. I can land a fast config patch.
lina: I have a tiny terraform snippet we can apply now for the edge binding. Patch ready: ```resource "redwood_edge_pool_borrow" "temp_borrow" { region = "us-west2" count = 4 duration_hours = 6 reason = "spot-surge-canonical-canary" }``` Can ops run the apply?
ops_oncall: I can run the apply, but need cost signoff since partner charge goes to run center. @simon-finance can you approve up to $2k for this emergency borrow? :pray:
simon-finance: Approving up to $2k for emergency canary. Please tag cost center RG-ml-inference and include exact hours.
kevin: Thanks — I'll open PR  #1324 with the tf and config bump. Quick snippet in PR body with runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/edge-borrow.
acme-rep: We also need serials for audit — will send rack serials + ETA once we hand off. Expect a 5-10m window for attach.
vendor-bot: borrow request queued: /borrow-edge --pool acme-satellite --region us-west2 --count 4 --ttl 6h --ticket 1324
maria: Great. ops_oncall please confirm when the borrow is active and i'll start the canary traffic shift (small percentage). :rocket: 
ops_oncall: Applying tf now, running plan -> apply. Will post results in threads.
ops_oncall: apply complete. Instances attached: acme-sat-203, acme-sat-204, acme-sat-205, acme-sat-206. Serial list sent to acme-rep via DM.
kevin: Canaries started at 3% traffic. Initial latency looks stable. I'll bump to 10% in 15m if no regressions.
maria: Thanks everyone. Post-mortem: if spot preemptions > 10% in an hour, we should have an auto-borrow policy. Filing follow-up task in eng-infra backlog. :memo:
